palettes.name: First guess: humus + gold / paper + ochre (current site + mockup A)
palettes.story: The center of the first guess: warm earth dark with bone text and a gold accent, and its paper twin with ink and ochre.

palettes.name: Second guess: ink navy + cream + cobalt / op-art black-white + signal
palettes.story: The center of the second guess: deep ink blue with cream text and an electric cobalt accent, the default 'serious creative technologist' look.

palettes.name: Teinte sensible
palettes.story: Under a polarising microscope, the first-order red near 550 nm is the most sensitive tint of the whole interference scale: a few nanometres of shift flip it to blue or to yellow.

palettes.name: Teinte sensible
palettes.story: Pencil graphite on neutral paper, plus one ink: first-order red, the magenta a physicist sees through a gypsum plate under crossed polarisers.

palettes.name: Strophaire vert-de-gris
palettes.story: One mushroom holds the whole palette: the verdigris agaric (Stropharia aeruginosa) has a blue-green cap, purple-grey gills and a purple-brown spore print.

palettes.name: Labradorite
palettes.story: Labradorite is a plain grey stone that flashes peacock blue-green when light meets its lamellae, layers thinner than 200 nm interfering inside the crystal.

palettes.name: Encre violette
palettes.story: The French school notebook: Seyès paper with its violet lines and blue interlines, written on in the methyl violet ink French classrooms used for a century; the dark side is the carbon sheet underneath.

palettes.name: Rhodochrosite
palettes.story: Sliced rhodochrosite stalactites show concentric rose bands laid down by rhythmic precipitation: a natural ring grating, close kin to the hero field radiating from the accent of the é.

palettes.name: Antireflet
palettes.story: An anti-reflection coating is interference used for comfort: a quarter-wave layer cancels the glare, and all that is left is a faint sea-green sheen with a magenta edge.

palettes.name: Vert-de-gris
palettes.story: Copper is what carries the current; left in the air it grows verdigris, the blue-green salt of old domes, roofs and lab fittings.

palettes.name: Lichen géographique
palettes.story: The map lichen (Rhizocarpon geographicum) tiles Alpine schist in yellow-green, each colony fenced by a black line of fungal threads, and geologists date moraines by measuring it.

palettes.name: 555 nm
palettes.story: The human eye is most sensitive at 555 nm, a yellow-green: the colour that needs the least light to be seen.

palettes.name: Tableau noir
palettes.story: The physicist's oldest instrument: the green slate board, chalk dust, one stick of lemon chalk for what matters.

palettes.name: Érythrite
palettes.story: Erythrite (cobalt bloom, crimson) and annabergite (nickel bloom, pale green) are the two ends of one continuous mineral series: swap cobalt for nickel atom by atom and the colour slides from one to the other.

palettes.name: Lycurgus
palettes.story: The Lycurgus cup, Roman glass from the 4th century, holds gold and silver nanoparticles: lit from the front it looks jade, lit from behind it glows ruby.

palettes.name: Deux encres
palettes.story: A risograph prints one drum per ink, and two slightly misregistered screens make the moiré printers fight.

palettes.name: Améthyste dans la mousse
palettes.story: The amethyst deceiver (Laccaria amethystina) trades with beech and oak through its roots, and its violet only shows while water moves through it: dry, it fades to buff.
